system.description:
• Trained within the Opal Mages Guild Association — founded by Jorhim Shadowstitch, training the magically gifted in exchange for their loyalty, now led by Archmage Elnora Myrill since the War of Tariel finally legitimised it in Myllnoris's eyes.
  • Coordinated Casting: Once per encounter, if an ally is already engaged with your target in melee, a harmful spell you cast against that target imposes Disadvantage on their saving throw.
  • Guild Standing: Recognised Guild standing — advantage on Persuasion invoking O.M.G.A.'s name with Opal's government or military, and advantage recalling the Guild's rank structure or current leadership.
